main_text.l: PAVLO MELISSO POETÆ CELEBERRIMO, QVVM PER literas à D. Beza petiisset sibi nomen indicari, quod notabatur tribus literis I. I. B. in quibusdam versibus anno 1590. emissis.

{M}Vsis orte bonis, Melisse, vatum Quos Germania fert decus perenne: Cui cingunt meritum caput Corollæ Lauri Cæsarea manu plicatæ, Cur nostrum tibi poscis explicari Nomen, quod notulis tribus minutis Signatum sibi vindicat pudenter Paucos versiculos, inelegantes Rudes, illepidos, & impolitos Expertes venerum, & suauitatum Quales vsque tuis nitent libellis, Doctis & lepidis, & expolitis?
Ne iustam tibi mouerint timemus Naufeam & reliquis bonis poetis Gerrarum leuium soni canori Gerris Trinacriis ineptiores, Versus pondere qui carent & arte, Quales temporibus Maronis olim

page.notes: The large initial M is a decorated woodcut letter. The word "Manios" is set at the right, apart from the verse. The first line of the poem has an initial letter joined to "Vsis". Printed text reads "M" with ornamental initial; the transcription of the initial is approximate.
